title: Delectatio et Dominium
description:
Delectatio et Dominium (DeD) is a modular SkyrimNet integration mod for a number of classic community adult mods and effects. It aims to immerse you in those mods through thoughtful integration into SkyrimNet's prompt and trigger systems: the LLM driving your NPCs doesn't just know what's happening — it reacts as the character would, narrates it in-story, and decides what happens next. In some instances, DeD even drives the functions itself: applying cum decals, executing paired animations, and applying tattoos. And it attempts to maintain complete compatibility with both main adult Skyrim frameworks, SexLab and OStim — pick either, or run both.

Integrated mods include: Baka Paired Animations - For escalating scenes that can end in adult encounters GunSlicer Poses - To allow NPCs to dance and pose emergently (and the player too) Fill Her Up Baka - For reaction to cumflated actors OCum Ascended/SLACS 2 + SCO ( Cum Overlays ) - For reactions to visible cum SlaveTats - For ambient reactions to naughty tattoos

The structural idea: a modular framework that can support a number of mods while requiring as few as one of them. Each module is a separable file-set with a FOMOD installer option, so you install only what you use.

Everything the LLM narrates is written in-story: cues and ambient narration describe what is happening as it happens — the model reacts as the character would, never breaking the scene to explain itself. Nothing fires at random; every interaction and pose is decided by SkyrimNet's model, in context, from the characters' personalities. Master toggles, an intensity slider, and per-module settings let you dial everything back.

The alpha testing continues. The Daedric influence modes have been enhanced, and several bugs have been squashed.

A big thank you to Around906 for the base integrations that this mod is build on top of. Their mods live on within this one.

Enjoy!
author: 7regalrascal7
changelog:
Delectatio et Dominium 0.4.0

Narrative Selection — the headline. Every ambient mode now casts its own scenes: one LLM call picks who acts, what they do, to whom, and why — from live context (bios, arousal, memories, recent events), not dice. And the "why" ships in the cue itself: "that display of strength is the first thing in this cursed room worth wanting." Toggle per module if you prefer plain cues.

Reaction lanes everywhere — direct narration / NPC thought / player speech / player thought, unified across GS poses and Baka actions, one lane per event in rotation, with a guaranteed acknowledgment floor so no pose happens unseen.

Triggers that say what happened — rich cue descriptions now flow directly into trigger text (live-proven {{ event_data }} channel). No more "something happened, react."

Arousal doctrine completed — the last mechanical banding retired. All reaction registers render as suggestions beside actual arousal facts; the LLM picks what fits the person and the moment.

Honest cadence — clocks arm at dispatch, not fire; missed LLM answers no longer burn cadence slots; fast modes auto-lean their prompts to stay affordable. 60s default.

The Acheron fix — the follower soft-lock is dead at its roots: Acheron rescues work on NPCs, Prisma HelpUp always releases, and standing over downed companions post-combat extends their wait by one minute, not forever.

Softer feet — EmoTears4NPCs is now a true soft dependency (it was never actually used). One hidden load-order constraint gone.

The theme: every "broken system" this cycle was a too-literal gatekeeper, while the model's answers kept being the healthiest layer. 0.4.0 stops second-guessing the model — complete information, honest timing, gates that check spelling. The mod now speaks in complete sentences.
